div.div:
Identity never comes from the client (ADR-0016). The ownerId is resolved server-side: USER#<cognito-sub> for an authenticated cart or GUEST#<guestId> for a visitor — the latter expires via TTL.
No caching layer (ADR-0013): the repository talks straight to DynamoDB.
